subject: general
question: A book with a printed price of Rs. 4,500 is available on successive discounts of 10%, 20% and 25%. Find the selling price of the bank.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Multiplying factor for 10% discount = 90/100 = 9/10.

Multiplying factor for 20% discount = 80/100 = 4/5.

Multiplying factor for 25% discount = 75/100 = 3/4.

**Selling Price** = 4500 × (9/10) × (4/5) × (3/4) = 4500 × (108/200) = 4500 × (27/50).

**Selling Price** = 90 × 27 = 2430.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 2,430.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Marked Price (MP) = Rs. 4,500; Discounts = 10%, 20%, 25%.

**Formulas:** SP = MP × (100 − d₁)/100 × (100 − d₂)/100 × (100 − d₃)/100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b765bac61ca4a1ee9aef003fa2eed8a3e8ddf4be0aa938c3bec308406a9d3996.png] 

⇒ Price after 1st discount = 4500 − (10% of 4500) = 4500 − 450 = 4050.

⇒ Price after 2nd discount = 4050 − (20% of 4050) = 4050 − 810 = 3240.

⇒ Final Selling Price = 3240 − (25% of 3240) = 3240 − 810 = 2430.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 2,430.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discounts

When a series of discounts are applied, the first discount is on the **Marked Price**, and subsequent discounts are on the reduced prices. Net discount % = a + b − (ab/100).

Selling Price Calculation

The final **Selling Price** can be calculated using the formula: SP = MP × (1 − d₁) × (1 − d₂) × (1 − d₃), where d represents the discount rate in decimals.</p
